//: build:web KEEPS its `pnpm run gen:types &&` chain deliberately. apps/frontend/Dockerfile.web installs with --filter ansari-frontend (which does not install root devDependencies, so turbo is absent from that image) and invokes build:web DIRECTLY. Without the chain, expo export runs with no uniwind-types.d.ts and the image build breaks. turbo.json also declares gen:types as a dependsOn edge of `build`, so under the graph the codegen has already run by the time this chain fires. This in-script call then runs uniwind a SECOND time — it does NOT become a Turbo cache hit, because `pnpm run` bypasses Turbo entirely. That duplicate is accepted deliberately: uniwind codegen is idempotent and takes well under a second, and the chain is what keeps the Docker path working. See turbo.json.
name: ansari-frontend

scripts.build:web: pnpm run gen:types && expo export --platform web
